result.finding: The application has four external dependencies: MySQL (Azure-managed via spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-mysql), HSQLDB (in-memory testing), Spring Cloud Config Server, and Netflix Eureka service registry. Connection configuration is delivered at runtime via the Config Server.
evidence: pom.xml: com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-mysql:5.20.1 - Azure MySQL managed identity support
pom.xml: org.hsqldb:hsqldb (runtime) - embedded in-memory database for testing profile
pom.xml: spring-cloud-starter-config - Spring Cloud Config Server client
application.yml: CONFIG_SERVER_URL env var with default http://localhost:8888/
values: MySQL - Purpose: primary relational database, Azure-managed
HSQLDB - Purpose: in-memory database for local/test profile
Spring Cloud Config Server - Purpose: centralized configuration management
Netflix Eureka - Purpose: service discovery and registration
